comments.content: Nested ternary is used here, which violates the project rule against nested ternaries and hurts readability. Additionally, the inner `hasHostProject ? A : B` is partly dead code: `mode` can only be `'page'` when `hasHostProject` is true (the mode selector is rendered only under `hasHostProject`, and the default is `'project'` otherwise), so the `'将在当前项目中追加一张新画布'` fallback branch is unreachable. Consider flattening by branching on `mode === 'project'` first.

comments.content: The visible caption is a plain `<div>`, so it is not programmatically associated with the input and clicking it does not focus the field (only the separate `aria-label` names the input). Prefer a `<label htmlFor="omnimux-fork-app-name">` tied to the input's id.
